headline: 198 RENA HAS A SECOND SHOWING REQUESTED FOR 10:30 TOMORROW MORNING — from the same eXp agent who texted at 8:07 this morning that his buyers had to sell their own house first — and the request is still sitting UNCONFIRMED on the day the listing agreement expires.

hotSignals.signal: 🔥 REPEAT SHOWING — Kyle B. of eXp Realty requested a SECOND tour for Friday 8/14 10:30–11:00 AM, and the ShowingTime notice proves it is his second: it prints "Showings by this Agent: 2". ⚠️ THE CONTRADICTION IS THE INTERESTING PART AND IT IS PRINTED RATHER THAN SMOOTHED — at 8:07 THIS MORNING the same agent texted, verbatim, "We have to get their house on the market befofe we look anymore." He booked five hours and fifty minutes later. Either those buyers reversed inside a morning, or he is bringing a different buyer. ⏰ Both readings land on the same fact: this is the first repeat interest this listing has produced in 88 days, and it arrives on the exact morning the listing agreement expires.
hotSignals.action: ⛔ CONFIRM THE REQUEST FIRST — it is unconfirmed and ShowingTime says the agent is expecting a response as soon as possible. Then call him before tomorrow: same buyers or new buyers is the single question, and the answer changes the price conversation you are having with the sellers the same day.

It is the first read filed since the $4,000 cut went live 8/5, and the price objection that had appeared on every prior read is simply gone.
hotSignals.action: Agent outreach already sent on this listing (Angela B., 8/3). Call, don't email — buyer's agents are the red lane.

hotSignals.action: Call her — five days unworked. Ask what her buyer liked and whether size is a problem, because the other two reads that same Saturday both said the house is too small.

oweFeedback.when: 🔴 THREE ASKS AND TWENTY-THREE DAYS OF SILENCE — Tue 7/21, Wed 7/22 and Thu 7/23, from the RealtySouth Inverness listing side after your 7/21 1:00 PM tour. ⭐ THIS IS THE ONE THAT COSTS SOMETHING REAL, and the cost is not the courtesy — it is that the honest written answer IS your counter on the largest number on your board, roughly $36K of GCI. The listing side has asked repeatedly to be moved forward; a seller who reverse-offers a buyer is a seller who wants a deal. Twenty minutes of writing moves it. ⚠️ The appraisal figure your buyer cited as far under ask is single-sourced from him — do not quote it to the other side as an appraised value.
